main_text.head: IOANNES CRISPINVS CHRISTIANIS LECTORIBVS.
main_text.p: VOLVMEN istud Actionum Martyrum,quum ad iustam ma-gnitudinem excreuisse videremus, Christiani Lectores, octauo demum libro claudendum duximus, ne vos diutius huius operis expe-ctatione suspensos teneremus, neue rerum praeclarissimarum à ἀνθρώποις[?] cuiuscunque generis, ordinis, aetatisque hominibus gestarū fru-ctu vtilitateque priuaremus: deinde vt maiori tum otio tum commo-ditate ad ea colligenda pergeremus, quae iam breui in Gallia Cardinalis ille Lotharingus piorum sanguine rubens dispersit ac dissipauit: inter quos egregiè cordatus Dei Martyr Annas à Burgo supremae Parisiē-sis Curiae senator, XXII.die mensis Decemb. anni M.D.LIX. admirabilem martyrij coronam accepit. Hispaniae quoque (cui nunc etiam sol iustitiae ac veritatis lux affulsit) Martyrū his temporibus actiones eadem editione Deo fauente, daturos nos speramus. Interea omnes hortari ac per sacrosanctum Christi martyrum ducis ac principis nomen obtestari non desinam vt in hoc opus tam vtile ac necessarium diligentiam omnem & operam conferatis.

page.notes: The Greek word at the end of the first line ("à ἀνθρώποις") is small and partly unclear; the reading is a best guess and is marked [?]. Its line-end continuation is also uncertain. The italic boundaries in the body are not fully certain, since some words could be roman or italic at this scan size; the paragraph is treated as italic from "gnitudinem" onward, with the roman "Parisiē-sis Curiae senator" section and "M.D.LIX." small capitals as printed. The initial "V" is a decorative woodcut letter, joined to "OLVMEN" in the transcription.
